en: A black-and-white panoramic view over a small alpine town nestled in a valley, with tiled-roof houses, church towers, and surrounding fields and hills. In the foreground there is a rustic wooden fence, and in the distance the landscape opens to farmland and mountains. Along the lower border of the image, printed text identifies the location as Cavalese in the Valle di Fiemme and notes its elevation.
